inv.verdict_meaning: Said out loud, never read as safe
inv.verdict_rule: too little evidence to certify safety — a verdict that names a failure mode still stands, only Robust/Ordinary collapse to here
failure_modes: The cash engine fell 78% from its 2020-12-31 peak to its 2022-12-31 trough and has since regained that peak — a cyclical engine, not a broken one.

The cash engine bent when the world tilted: the 2020 demand shock left owner earnings 78% ABOVE the prior peak (2020-12-31); the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 78% below the prior peak (2022-12-31) and it came back.

This business resists valuation: annual revenue growth is typically 11 points away from its 24%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 2 points away from its 14% average — what cannot be valued must be avoided however cheap it looks.
